leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a custom ref using the useImperativeHandle hook
Configure parent components to access child component methods via refs
Control which child component methods are exposed to parent components
Initialize ref forwarding between parent and child components
Manipulate child component state from parent components using exposed methods
Integrate useImperativeHandle with forwardRef for functional components
Construct a form validation pattern where parent components trigger child validation methods
